mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NM AS userNm, J.CD_NM AS jbgdNm, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, U.AUTHRT_CD AS authrtCd, U.ENPSWD AS enpswd, U.ACNT_STTS_CD AS acntSttsCd FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD J ON J.GROUP_CD = 'JBGDS' AND J.CD = U.JBGD_CD WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER SET LGN_FAIL_NMTM = LGN_FAIL_NMTM + 1, MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE TB_USER SET LGN_FAIL_NMTM = 0, MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND LGN_FAIL_NMTM <> 0
